references.observation: Description separates scene observations from deductions and revisits completed cases; screenshot review unavailable.
references.principle: Evidence and conclusions should be distinguishable functional surfaces.
references.application: Place clue statements alongside the editable chronology with independent truth marks.
references.avoid: Do not reproduce characters, illustrated scenes or branded interface elements.

references.observation: Official description shows evidence leading to progressively constrained family tree placements.
references.principle: Progress is made by resolving placement constraints rather than collecting arbitrary points.
references.application: Use a finite set of records whose logical ordering is constrained by the clues.
references.avoid: Do not copy the family tree structure, artwork, narratives or identity puzzles.

references.observation: Rules explain selecting word groups and distinct visual outcomes for correct groups.
references.principle: Short, explicit feedback helps users reason about a discrete selection.
references.application: Mark each clue as consistent or contradictory after every exchange.
references.avoid: Do not duplicate the sixteen-word grid, grouping rules or category color scheme.

concepts.medium: Typeset DOM and paper-like CSS records
concepts.composition: Open archival document with timeline and clue lists
concepts.interaction: Select two records to exchange their positions
concepts.motion: Short paper impression immediately after each exchange
concepts.rationale: Legibility and exact spatial order suit deduction on small touch screens.

concepts.medium: Vector brass clock and moving circular pointers
concepts.composition: Radial dial with events on numbered clock positions
concepts.interaction: Rotate hands to assign events to angular slots
concepts.motion: Rotational movement settles into evenly spaced notches
concepts.rationale: Interesting tactile appearance but circular reading obscures chronological order.

concepts.medium: Illustrated isometric archive drawers and index cards
concepts.interaction: Open drawers and drag selected objects between compartments
concepts.motion: Depth transitions and sliding furniture respond to touch
concepts.rationale: Strong atmosphere but occlusion and extra navigation complicate the core deduction.

selection.reason: The document layout makes order and evidence simultaneously legible without precision gestures or hidden controls.

rejected.reason: Circular arrangement introduces ambiguity between first and last position for chronological puzzles.
Object occlusion and drawer navigation add effort unrelated to logical reasoning.

tools.reason: Authored vector icon and native CSS paper geometry require no asset pipeline.
No local Playwright module or direct repository network access in this runtime.
tools.fallback: Use hosted GitHub browser QA and inspect actual artifact images before merge.

assets.role: Recognizable document and stamped checkmark at launcher size.
assets.acceptance: Page silhouette and red stamp remain distinct at 48 pixels.
assets.integration: Manifest, launcher and browser tab load the app-owned SVG.
assets.provenance: Original vector artwork authored for this project without external imagery.

risks: Seven records may require intentional vertical scroll on short screens.
Contrast of clue marks and clipping of long labels must be reviewed.
